mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, potentially increasing ranolazine levels through CYP3A4 inhibition and increasing risk of serotonergic effects; ranolazine may also have weak serotonergic activity.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution with close cardiac and blood pressure monitoring; consider alternative antianginal or antidepressant agents.
